LanguageData.AIPawnControl_ThinkingTip: Slower (about 5x) and uses many more tokens. Off sends reasoning_effort=none.
LanguageData.AIPawnControl_LogPromptsTip: Writes every request and reply to AIPawnControl/prompts-DATE.jsonl in the save data folder.
LanguageData.AIPawnControl_SpeakLinesTip: Her talks, remarks and first line show her own words in bubbles and the social log. Off: vanilla text only.
LanguageData.AIPawnControl_ChatBubblesTip: Her replies in the Mind tab chat also appear as a speech bubble over her.
LanguageData.AIPawnControl_AllowBuildingTip: AI colonists may plan new rooms and furnish rooms they built. They only place blueprints; the colony builds them. Off: no new projects; a running one is left as-is.
LanguageData.AIPawnControl_AllowChoresTip: AI colonists may mark animals to hunt, trees to cut and rock to mine, and lay out fields; new rooms get their own bills, stockpiles and materials. The colony does the work. Off: no new chores; what's set up stays.
LanguageData.AIPawnControl_AnswerChoicesTip: An AI colonist (the best negotiator who's free) decides when a wanderer or lodger wants to join, a ransom is demanded, a quest is offered on the home map, or beggars ask for items. The decision is posted in the group chat. You can still answer first. Quests away from home, choosing a pawn, babies and growth moments stay yours.
LanguageData.AIPawnControl_MindsAnswerTip: When an AI colonist talks to another AI colonist, the other one answers with a line of their own, and may agree to help. Off: only the first line is said.
LanguageData.AIPawnControl_ParallelRequestsTip: How many requests go to the model server at once. More than 1 only helps if the server runs requests in parallel (LM Studio's parallel option). Waiting requests go in order: your chat, answers between colonists, decisions, then the base, personas and nightly reflection.
LanguageData.AIPawnControl_MemoryTip: Off: no nightly reflection and no recalled memories in prompts. What happens is still noted.
LanguageData.AIPawnControl_EmbedTestOk: OK in {0}s: the model makes {1}-number vectors; memories store {2}.
LanguageData.AIPawnControl_EmbedTestFailed: No working embedding model there: {0}. Memories still work, found by people, place, importance and recency only.
LanguageData.AIPawnControl_EmbedNotTested: Not tested with this model yet.
LanguageData.AIPawnControl_MindToggleDesc: Let an AI run {0}'s life. It picks who to talk to and what the base gets next, and sets their work by their passions. The player can still draft them or give orders.
LanguageData.AIPawnControl_EnableNoteLabel: Optional character note (a secret goal, a quirk, how they see the colony). Leave empty to build the persona from their backstory and traits only.
LanguageData.AIPawnControl_ManualPrioritiesOff: AI mind: manual work priorities are off, so the AI can only switch work types on or off. Turn on manual priorities in the Work tab to let it rank them.
LanguageData.AIPawnControl_TabManualOff: Manual work priorities are off: work types can only be switched on or off.
LanguageData.AIPawnControl_ChatWaiting: {0} is unconscious and will answer after coming to.
LanguageData.AIPawnControl_GroupChatTurn: {0}'s turn to write. Your messages don't start anything; the next colonist sees them.
LanguageData.AIPawnControl_GroupChatNoMinds: No colonist has an AI mind yet.
LanguageData.AIPawnControl_MemoriesEvents: events, last 7 days ({0}), newest first: when · kind · source · importance · people · place
